tasks.title: query: count table rows that match a condition
tasks.task: how many products are out of stock?
tasks.reference: const rows = await page.locator('tbody tr').all(); let n = 0; for (const r of rows) { if ((await r.locator('td').nth(2).innerText()) === '0') n++; } return n

tasks.title: query: compare values across a table
tasks.reference: const rows = await page.locator('tbody tr').all(); let best = ''; let min = Infinity; for (const r of rows) { const price = Number((await r.locator('td').nth(1).innerText()).replace('$', '')); if (price < min) { min = price; best = await r.locator('td').first().innerText(); } } return best
